cohort: 2961 preterm infants born at 22-29 weeks of gestation
finding: Lower gestational age was associated with an increased risk of both symptomatic PDA and secondary ligation, while maternal pregnancy-induced hypertension and surfactant use increased the risk of symptomatic PDA, and antenatal corticosteroid use decreased it.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was a significant risk factor for secondary ligation for PDA.
